sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivī ahorātre nakṣatrapeśaḥ | idam aham amuṣminn āmuṣyāyaṇe 'muṣyāḥ putre duṣvapnyaṃ vrajet ||
english: O Heaven and Earth, O Day and Night, O you adorned with constellations — let the evil dream pass from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so.

sanskrit: yad asmāsv ity āṣṭādaśakī ||
english: "Whatever evil is upon us" — thus the eighteen-verse hymn.

sanskrit: mā pra gāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñād indra sominaḥ | mānta sthur no arātayaḥ ||
english: May we not stray from the path, O Indra, nor from the sacrifice of the soma-pressers; may enmities not stand between us.

sanskrit: yo yajñasya prasādhanas tantur deveṣv ātataḥ | tam āhutam aśīmahi ||
english: He who is the accomplisher of the sacrifice, the thread stretched out among the gods — may we partake of him who has received the oblation.

sanskrit: namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tad ṛtaṃ saparyata | dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divas putrāya sūryāya śaṃsata ||
english: Reverence to the eye of Mitra and Varuṇa, to the great god — honor that cosmic order; proclaim the far-seeing one, born of the gods, the beacon, the son of heaven, the sun.

sanskrit: dyāvā ca tatra tatatanann ahāni ca na te adevaḥ pradivo vi vāsati | yad etaśebhiḥ pratarai ratharyasi prācīnam anyad anu vartate raja ud anyena jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya ||
english: Heaven and the days are spread out there; no ungodly one dwells before you from ancient times. When you race with your swift horses in your chariot, one dominion follows the east and you travel, O Sun, upward by another light.

sanskrit: yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tamo jagac ca viśvam abhīyarṣi bhānunā | tenāsmad viśvām anirām anāhutim apāmīvām apa duṣvapnyaṃ suva ||
english: O Sun, with that very light by which you thrust away darkness and pervade the entire universe with your radiance — drive away from us by that same power all distress, all that is unsacrificed, all disease, and the evil dream.

sanskrit: viśvām anirām amīvām anāhutim amuṣmā āmuṣyāyaṇāyāmuṣyāḥ putrāya pra hiṇmaḥ ||
english: All distress, disease, and what is unsacrificed — we send these away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so.

sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivī vahataṃ duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahataṃ duṣvapnyam | amuṣmā āmuṣyāyaṇāyāmuṣyāḥ putrāya ||
english: O Heaven and Earth, carry away the evil dream, carry it far away — from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so.

sanskrit: vātāpavamānau vahatam (…) ||
english: O Wind and Purifier, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: indrāgnī vahatam (…) ||
english: O Indra and Agni, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: mitrāvaruṇā vahatam (…) ||
english: O Mitra and Varuṇa, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: bhavāśarvau vahatam (…) ||
english: O Bhava and Śarva, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: devāśvinā vahataṃ duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahataṃ duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Aśvins, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: devā maruto vahata duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahata duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Maruts, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: devāḥ pitaro vahata duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahata duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Fathers, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva sūrya vaha duṣvapnyaṃ parā vaha duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Sun, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva candramo vaha duṣvapnyaṃ parā vaha duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Moon, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: devā nakṣatrāṇi vahata duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahata duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Constellations, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: devīr āpo vahata duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahata duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Waters, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva viṣṇo vaha duṣvapnyam (…) ||
english: O divine Viṣṇu, carry away the evil dream [carry the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva tvaṣṭar vaha (…) ||
english: O divine Tvaṣṭṛ, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva dhātar vaha (…) ||
english: O divine Dhātṛ, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva savitar vaha (…) ||
english: O divine Savitṛ, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva pūṣan vaha (…) ||
english: O divine Pūṣan, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva bṛhaspate vaha (…) ||
english: O divine Bṛhaspati, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva prajāpate vaha (…) ||
english: O divine Prajāpati, carry it away [carry away the evil dream far away from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: deva parameṣṭhin vaha duṣvapnyaṃ parā vaha duṣvapnyam | (…) ||
english: O divine Parameṣṭhin, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away [from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so].

sanskrit: ahorātre vahataṃ duṣvapnyaṃ parā vahataṃ duṣvapnyam | amuṣmā āmuṣyāyaṇāyāmuṣyāḥ putrāya ||
english: O Day and Night, carry away the evil dream, carry the evil dream far away — from this man, son of so-and-so, offspring of so-and-so.

sanskrit: indro vajram asiñcad vṛtrāya hantave | tvaṣṭā vajram asiñcad vṛtrāya hantave ||
english: Indra poured out the thunderbolt to slay Vṛtra; Tvaṣṭṛ poured out the thunderbolt to slay Vṛtra.

sanskrit: yo vajraḥ sa viśvānaro yat tegmavīryaṃ sa viśvāṣāḍ yad dhārambhaṇaṃ sa vaiśvānaraḥ ||
english: That which is the thunderbolt, that is the Viśvānara fire; that which possesses sharp power, that is the all-conquering Viśvāṣāḍ; that which has the edge that can be grasped, that is Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit: etad vā idaṃ sarvaṃ yad etāni trīṇi | viśvānaro vaiśvānaro viśvāṣāṭ ||
english: All this indeed is these three: Viśvānara, Vaiśvānara, and Viśvāṣāṭ.

sanskrit: sarvān eva puṇyāṃl lokān ava rundhe sarvāś ca devatā ya evaṃ vidvān anaḍuho vrataṃ bibharti ||
english: He wins all the meritorious worlds and all the divinities, who, knowing thus, observes the vow of the bullock.
